metadata.notes: Audit-and-replace of auto-seeded placeholder picks for all 30 Kerala destinations. KTDC (Kerala Tourism Development Corporation), Kerala Forest Department eco-tourism lodges and temple-devaswom guesthouses used as government anchors. Houseboats, heritage homestays and Ayurveda resorts are genuine deep inventory in Kerala. ~66% of picks failed verification as keep_existing (61 replace + 13 honest_scarcity of 112). Key fabrications/ghosts caught: Taj Exotica Alleppey (no such property — Taj Exotica is Goa/Maldives), Athirapally Marriott (no Marriott at the falls), The Leela Kumarakom (no Leela in Kumarakom — Leela's backwater hotel is Leela Ashtamudi). Cross-dest contaminations: Ashtamudi Palace at Kannur (Ashtamudi is Kollam, 250km), Bekal Fort resort at Kannur (Bekal is Kasaragod), Taj Bekal at Kollam (400km), Taj Kumarakom at Kuttanad and Sabarimala, Coconut Lagoon 'near Kovalam' (Coconut Lagoon is Kumarakom), Wayanad Silverwoods at Kozhikode, Deshadan at Idukki (brand is Munnar), Sterling Anaikatti at Silent Valley (Anaikatti is the TN border near Coimbatore), Kumbalangi Nights as a Kuttanad property (it is a 2019 film). Honest-scarcity (13 slots): Eravikulam value+xfactor (no accommodation inside the national park — Munnar base); Ponmudi value+location+xfactor (KTDC Golden Peak is the only stay on the hill); Marari value+xfactor; Bekal/Beypore/Kumbalangi/Thrissur/Athirapally xfactor; Sabarimala xfactor (forest pilgrim shrine, TDB lodging only). All cases where no distinct verifiable tier-1/2 property remains beyond what fills the other slots. Silent Valley itself stayed in replace (Forest Department log house / eco-camp / gateway-village homestays are genuine). Government anchors used: KTDC across many dests, Travancore Devaswom Board for Sabarimala, Guruvayur Devaswom for Guruvayur, Kerala Forest Department for Chinnar/Silent Valley.
